Case: Patient D is a 51-year-old Black man with renal cell carcinoma status-post T4-T7 corpectomy and fusion for spine metastases 6 months ago who presents with progressive leg pain. Specifically, he endorses that in addition to mid-back pain, he is experiencing shooting pains down both legs. Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
